content.text:
Prefer separate neutral action and focus tokens. Keep `--accent` as the inherited entity palette.

| Owner | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `tokens.css` | Off-white action color, neutral action ink, focus color, and existing MP/funder colors. |
| `actions.css` | All action variants, hover states, and action focus. Replace hardcoded purple subtle colors with neutral tokens or neutral mixes. |
| `patterns.css` | Neutral search focus border/caret and native focus rings. Preserve entity badges, legends, highlights, charts, and identity styling through `--accent`. |
| `Field.svelte` | Neutral input outline through the shared focus token. |
| Features | Existing entity scopes only. Search suggestions inherit neutral actions automatically. |
| Gallery/docs | Explain action, focus, and entity roles. Show neutral actions inside both entity scopes. |

Repurposing root `--accent` to off-white requires adding explicit member scopes wherever purple is currently implicit. This includes MP search results and legend, member identity/totals, bars, highlights, gallery chart fixtures, and composition examples. It also leaves funder-scoped actions teal unless those controls explicitly escape inherited accent. The wider migration offers little benefit for this request.

Coverage risks observed:

- `subtle` hardcodes purple text, border, surface, and hover colors independently of `--accent`.
- Focus appears in `actions.css`, `patterns.css`, `Field.svelte`, and gallery-local CSS. Updating only native global outlines leaves component outlines colored.
- Search focus uses both border color and caret color.
- `design-system.spec.ts` explicitly requires teal funder action focus today. Replace that expectation with neutral focus under both entity palettes.
- Preserve entity-specific presentation assertions alongside neutral-control assertions so the change cannot accidentally remove MP purple or funder teal.
- Gallery prose currently promises “accent focus,” and its funder example implies controls inherit entity color. Both need updating.
